newsitem.title: JAPAN: Megane Top rises after good debut.
newsitem.headline: Megane Top rises after good debut.

text.p: Megane Top Corp shares rose on Wednesday in over-the-counter trade as investors welcomed the firm's good debut on the previous day, brokers said.
As of 0508 GMT, the shares stood at 3,050 yen, up from the initial trade price of 2,840 on Tuesday.
The initial offer price of the shares was 2,660.

"Judging from the PER forecast, the share price has the potential to rise to about 3,000 yen," a broker at a middle-sized brokerage said. "Neither the initial offer nor the trading price were overheated, which is encouraging for investors."
